investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Cluster Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-27T13:20–13:27Z because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected as Unschedulable: the 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource reported insufficient capacity, and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the pod never left the Pending state, so the eval runner could not reach the agent creation or readiness steps required by the expected-output contract.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes scheduler could not place the remote-agent pod on any of the 6 available nodes: the 2 nodes advertising the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource had no remaining allocatable VM slots (Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm), and the other 4 nodes were excluded by the pod's node affinity/selector rules. Preemption was also unavailable on both node groups. Because the pod remained unscheduled for ~136–145 s (exceeding the probe's implicit readiness window), the eval runner surfaced the scheduler message as the check failure and returned an empty evidence object, causing all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) to be missing and all contract assertions to be unverifiable. This is an eval-observed infrastructure scheduling constraint, not a confirmed user-traffic outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api because every pod spawned by the eval runner was stuck unschedulable: the two nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource were fully exhausted, and the remaining four nodes did not match the pod's node affinity or selector. No agent was ever created, so zero evidence fields were collected and the expected-output contract (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) was entirely unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents swarm runtime has insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity to schedule new agent pods.
